name: grants
description: Grants.gov / Simpler.Grants.gov: US federal grant opportunities. The CLI searches and exports funding opportunities, gets opportunity details from the classic Grants.gov web service, looks up agencies, searches site content, reads CMS pages, and lists the daily XML database extracts and RSS feeds.

commands.name: search-opportunities
commands.summary: Search federal funding opportunities on simpler.grants.gov by keyword, with status, funding-instrument, eligibility and category filters, sort and paging. Returns the raw Next.js RSC text payload, whi

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword search text

params.name: sortby
params.description: Sort order. Relevancy is the default.

params.name: status
params.description: Opportunity status. Comma-separate multiple values: forecasted, posted, closed, archived. The UI default is forecasted,posted.

params.name: fundingInstrument
params.description: Funding instrument. Comma-separate multiple values: grant, cooperative_agreement, procurement_contract, other.

params.name: eligibility
params.description: Eligible applicant type code, comma-separated, e.g. nonprofits_non_higher_education_with_501c3, state_governments, individuals

params.name: category
params.description: Funding category code, comma-separated, e.g. health, education, environment, science_technology_and_other_research_and_development

params.name: page
params.description: Results page number, starting at 1

commands.name: export-opportunities-csv
commands.summary: Export opportunity search results as CSV. Takes the same keyword, filter and sort params as search-opportunities.

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword search text

params.name: sortby
params.description: Sort order

params.name: status
params.description: Comma-separated statuses: forecasted, posted, closed, archived

params.name: fundingInstrument
params.description: Comma-separated: grant, cooperative_agreement, procurement_contract, other

params.name: eligibility
params.description: Comma-separated eligible applicant type codes, e.g. nonprofits_non_higher_education_with_501c3

params.name: category
params.description: Comma-separated funding category codes, e.g. health

commands.name: get-opportunity-details
commands.summary: Get full details of an opportunity from the classic Grants.gov web service, by numeric opportunity ID. Includes synopsis, forecast, eligibility, attachments and version history.

params.name: oppId
params.description: Numeric Grants.gov opportunity ID, as in www.grants.gov/search-results-detail/{id}

commands.verifyNote: write: dry-run preview only, not sent

commands.name: search-agencies
commands.summary: Search funding agencies by name, for use as the agency filter in opportunity search.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Agency name fragment

params.name: status
params.description: Only agencies that have opportunities in this status

commands.verifyNote: write: dry-run preview only, not sent

commands.name: search-site-content
commands.summary: Search Grants.gov website content (help articles, forms, learning pages) through the Search.gov API.

params.name: query
params.description: Search text

params.name: offset
params.description: Result offset

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: get-content-page
commands.summary: Get a published Grants.gov CMS page (Storyblok story) by slug.

params.name: slug
params.description: Page slug (full_slug), e.g. site-search-results

commands.name: list-xml-extracts
commands.summary: List the daily Grants.gov XML database extract files (GrantsDBExtractYYYYMMDDv2.zip), with download URL, size and date.

commands.name: list-rss-feeds
commands.summary: List the Grants.gov RSS feed links for new and modified opportunities, by agency and by category.

notes: Opportunity search runs on simpler.grants.gov. search-opportunities returns raw Next.js RSC text, not clean JSON; the result records are embedded in that text. export-opportunities-csv returns the same results as CSV, but it returned 0 bytes in the headless browser, so it may need a real client.

Simpler.grants.gov detail pages are /opportunity/{uuid}, and attachments are hosted on files.simpler.grants.gov. No detail page UUID was captured in the recording. Use get-opportunity-details with the numeric classic opportunity ID instead.
Saving an opportunity requires signing in with Login.gov. The explorer was not logged in, so no save request was captured and no save command exists.
The 'Download all' attachments action on detail pages closed the browser page, so no request was captured for it.
XML extract files are large (about 78 MB zip) and hosted on S3 (prod-grants-gov-chatbot.s3.amazonaws.com/extracts/). Download them directly from the url field.
RSS feed URLs from list-rss-feeds may redirect to page-not-found. GG_NewOppByCategory.xml did when tried.
The Search.gov access_key and the Storyblok token are public keys the site's own web app sends; they are fixed in the URLs.
